crownPassive.name: Hunter's mark
crownPassive.text: Each round, while planning, choose one enemy hero. All your attacks on it deal +1 damage, and if it is a Beast it can't heal that round.

bond.text: His attacks deal +1 damage to Beasts for each other Märchen hero you field.
bond.name: Told by the hearth

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard Ranged attack: damage equal to Attack, on any enemy card.

actions.name: Stones in the belly
actions.text: A Ranged attack for his Attack that also drops the target's Speed to 1 for the rest of the fight.
